en-US.name: Kitchen Table Trivia Premium
en-US.summary: Unlimited bonus rounds for the whole household.
en-US.description: Bonus rounds for everyone in the house: five trivia questions at a time in history, science, geography, space, animals, sports, food, music, words, or a mix, as many as you like. The daily question and the leaderboard stay free. Billed monthly after a free week.

customProductPrompts.purchasePromptDescription: Kitchen Table Trivia Premium adds unlimited five-question bonus rounds for the whole household, in any category.
customProductPrompts.boughtCardDescription: You now have Kitchen Table Trivia Premium. Say "bonus round" anytime.

inSkillProductDefinition.testingInstructions: Say "play a bonus round" (or "buy premium"). Either subscription (premium or premium_annual) unlocks bonus rounds.
